arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Maurer argued the law favors preferred candidates. He compared it to a prior Supreme Court case.
Justice Kagan noted a difference from that prior case. She said the prior law had a discriminatory restriction.
Mr. Phillips argued public funding increases electoral competition. He stated the law combats real and apparent corruption.
